visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds an iPhone 15 Pro Max showcasing a mountain landscape lock screen with a large 'iOS 26' slogan overlay; the background is a blurred office setup. (2) The hand interacts with a new control center featuring transparent, rounded-rectangle widgets and glass-morphism effects. (3) A passcode screen is shown with unique circular translucent buttons that exhibit a depth-shifting effect when pressed. (4) A 3D wallpaper demonstration shows a man in sunglasses standing before a river and mountains; the clock shifts behind his head to show depth. (5) A grayscale image of a classic Audi car is used to show 3D depth effects shifting with the phone's gyroscope. (6) A man with short black hair and glasses wearing a dark green shirt sits in a studio with horizontal blinds, holding the phone toward the camera while talking. (7) A side-by-side comparison of a 'Windows Vista' system information screen on a PC monitor and the new mobile UI is shown to highlight aesthetic similarities. (8) The hand swipes through a dense grid of icons on the home screen, highlighting new glass-textured UI elements and overlapping translucent layers. (9) A split-screen comparison shows 'iOS 26' on the left and 'iOS 18' on the right to emphasize the more transparent background of the new control center. (10) The camera interface is displayed, showing a simplified bottom bar with 'Video' and 'Photo' as primary toggles and a redesigned focus ring. (11) A close-up of the Dynamic Island shows a charging notification stating '26 mins to 80%' with a green battery icon. (12) A comparison of the old and new Zhuyin keyboard layouts is shown, demonstrating a shift from slanted to vertical alignment of characters. (13) The user toggles a 'Clear' mode for home screen icons, causing them to turn into monochrome, semi-transparent outlines against the wallpaper.
